name: What specific questions should I ask a developer when comparing projects?

mainEntity.name: What specific questions should I ask a developer when comparing projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing projects, always ask about the developer's track record, specific completion timelines, exact inclusions in the unit, and the details of the HOA fees. Inquiry about the developer's past projects, including their on-time delivery rate and quality, provides crucial first-party insight into reliability. Additionally, understanding the process clarity of their change order policy and available upgrade options is important, as these can significantly impact the final cost and features of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask developers about their track record, completion timelines, unit inclusions, HOA fees, and change order policies. This helps assess reliability and final costs.
